pages.text: $(o)Anomalies$() are stationary environmental hazards found only in the $(l)Wasteland$(). They are not animals, and they take no interest in you personally - they simply do what they do to anything inside their radius.

pages.title: Rules of the Zone
pages.text: You $(o)cannot$() kill them - weapons, explosions, fire, and falls all register as nothing. Each is removed only by its own $(o)counterplay$(). $(br)Placement is fixed per world seed, they never move on or despawn, and once cleared they stay cleared.

pages.title: Read the Air
pages.text: Every variant announces itself with an ambient sound, a particle haze, and a shimmer. The effect reaches well past the visible core, so scout the edge before committing. $(br)If the air is humming, crackling, or warping - stop walking.

pages.title: Spoils
pages.text: Clearing an anomaly through its counterplay drops $(item)Resonite Shards$() - the raw material for crystals. The reward survives the collapse blast. $(br)Radioactive anomalies have no counterplay, so they drop nothing; mark them, route around them, move on.
